consistency_internal.explantion: Both response a and response b exhibit the same high‑severity internal‑consistency failures: each conflates the steel shortage with the microchip shortage, leaves the relative importance of competing causes unresolved, presents the steel‑chip link as a universally accepted fact (false consensus), and fails to attribute key claims to specific sources.
